survivors.claim: AC-20260912-05-1's clause 'a root with roadmap surfaces and no seed SHALL CONTINUE TO build byte-identically to today' is asserted by the test as run-to-run determinism of the same script, not as identity with the pre-image; against the real f0a9d25 script the built index.html differs on every root, because page()'s inline stylesheet lost the two D6-deleted CSS rules. The clause is unsatisfiable as written given D6, and the test cannot observe the thing the AC names.
survivors.impact: The regression pin for the no-seed atlas build proves only that the build is deterministic, not that it matches what shipped before; a future change to the shared page chrome would pass this pin unnoticed.
survivors.evidence: Built the same fixture with the base script (git show f0a9d25:spec/scripts/design-atlas.js, lib/templates symlinked) and with HEAD's script, then cmp: 'differ: char 54965, line 794'; diff shows exactly two removed lines: .statelabel{...} and .gapcard{...} — the D6 deletions. Test at :193-197 compares atlas build output to a second atlas build of the same code, never to the pre-image. Sanctioned by D6, so advisory: the delta is exactly the decided one.

The deviations sidecar records this; it is listed here so disposition sees it.
survivors.impact: A served mock with no closing body tag now gets its notes script appended without a separating newline — invisible in every current fixture, but the Decision's 'no behavior change' claim is not literally true.
